title: Desert island
summary: Ten strangers, one island's worth of supplies, no rescue in sight.
intro: Your plane crashes on a deserted island with nine strangers. Rescue could take weeks or years. What you choose says something about how you treat people who are, for now, all you have.

questions.prompt: Food is scarce. How do you divide the first week's rations?
questions.scenario: Two are children, one is elderly and frail, the rest are healthy adults.

questions.prompt: One person hasn't done any work in two weeks, citing a bad back no one can verify.

options.label: Confront them directly and ask them to try
Give them a smaller ration until they contribute

questions.prompt: A distant smoke signal might be a passing ship. Reaching the ridge to signal it means crossing unstable cliffs — two people have already been hurt trying.

options.label: Let whoever wants to try, volunteer

questions.prompt: A tenth survivor washes up a month later, sick and unable to work for weeks. Supplies are already tight.

options.label: Take them in and share equally
Take them in on a reduced share until they can contribute
The group already agreed to fend for itself

questions.prompt: You find seeds that could grow food in a few months — if you don't eat them now while people are hungry today.
